PaginationSchema.title: PaginationSchema
PaginationSchema.description:
Pagination data schema

Attributes:
    total_items (int): total number of elements
    page (int): current page
    items_per_page (int): number of items per page
    next_page (int | None): number of the next page
    prev_page (int | None): number of the previous page
    total_pages (int): number of total pages

message.title: Message
message.default: Bad Request: The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax.

message.title: Message
message.default: Unauthorized: The request requires user authentication or the provided authentication is invalid.

message.title: Message
message.default: Forbidden: The server understood the request, but it refuses to authorize it.
examples: Forbidden: You do not have permission to access this resource.

message.title: Message
message.default: Not Found: The requested resource could not be found on the server.
examples: Not Found: The requested user does not exist.
Not Found: Resource with the specified ID not found.

message.title: Message
message.default: Payload Too Large: The request is larger than the server is willing or able to process.
examples: Payload Too Large: The uploaded file exceeds the maximum allowed size.

message.title: Message
message.default: Unprocessable Entity: The server understands the content type of the request entity, but was unable to process the contained instructions.
examples: Unprocessable Entity: The provided data is invalid.

message.title: Message
message.default: Too Many Requests: The user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time.
examples: Too Many Requests: Rate limit exceeded.

message.title: Message
message.default: Internal Server Error: The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.
examples: Internal Server Error: Unexpected error occurred.

message.title: Message
message.default: Service Unavailable: The server is currently unable to handle the request due to temporary overloading or maintenance of the server.
examples: Service Unavailable: The server is under maintenance.
